contracts.label: Q Questions
contracts.mayCoexist: 134 editorial-normalisation rows are shipped so the search index can find a question a reader half-remembers in cleaned-up form.
contracts.neverDisplayed: Those 134 must never count toward any total, never highlight in a post, and never display as Q-authored. They are identified by editorialNormalization or neverDisplayAsQ.

contracts.label: Q Directives
contracts.mayCoexist: None. Every actionRequests entry is a certified directive.
contracts.countedBy: every actionRequests string across all posts

contracts.label: Q Claims
contracts.mayCoexist: Predictions share the assertion family and the same storage, separated by claimMeta.displayClass. editorialParaphrases are stored per post and are NOT claims.
contracts.neverDisplayed: An editorial paraphrase must never be presented as Q’s literal wording.
contracts.countedBy: postAnalysis.claims entries whose displayClass is claim

contracts.label: Q Predictions
contracts.mayCoexist: A prediction IS an assertion; the combined 4,811 figure is only ever shown labelled as combined.

contracts.label: Evidence & References
contracts.mayCoexist: URLs embedded inside pasted source material exist in the data and are labelled as such. They are references a reader can follow, but they are not Q citing a source.
contracts.neverDisplayed: An embedded-in-source URL must never be presented as a Q citation.
contracts.sourceResolution: value appears in the post text, or is a media asset attached to the post

contracts.label: Q Entities
contracts.mayCoexist: Canonical entities (1,332) and mentions (7,903) are DIFFERENT metrics, not a row-count mismatch — one entity is mentioned many times. The headline covers every resolved mention: 4,463 from the 93-entity core registry plus 3,440 from the 1,239 adjudicated-tail entities. Unresolved alias tokens are counted in neither.
contracts.neverDisplayed: An unresolved alias must never be shown as a resolved identification.
contracts.sourceResolution: alias text appears in the post, outside URL spans

contracts.label: Q Themes
contracts.mayCoexist: Multi-label by design: 378 posts carry more than one theme, so assignments exceed posts. Legacy extractor tags are not counted.
contracts.neverDisplayed: A legacy tag must never be shown as a certified theme.
contracts.sourceResolution: contextual — a theme is inferred from the drop, not a literal span

contracts.label: Codes & Brackets
contracts.mayCoexist: Detected as a code does not mean decoded: 734 of 739 ship with no interpretation, which is the honest state.
contracts.neverDisplayed: An undecoded code must never be shown with an invented meaning.
contracts.sourceResolution: exact characters preserved from the drop

contracts.label: Q Emphasis
contracts.mayCoexist: 245 arguable devices are held in the Resolution Center and counted in neither direction.
contracts.neverDisplayed: A queued borderline case must never appear as certified emphasis.
contracts.sourceResolution: sourceText appears within its recorded line, and the line within the post

contracts.label: Resolution Center
contracts.mayCoexist: Every row here is DELIBERATELY excluded from its section’s certified totals. That exclusion is the point of the section, not a gap in it.
contracts.neverDisplayed: A community suggestion must never alter certified data without re-entering audit → adjudication → materialise → QA → apply → deploy.
contracts.sourceResolution: each row deep-links to the occurrence it came from

overlaps.why: An information request ("Define X.") is grammatically an instruction and functionally a question. Each section asks a different thing of the same unit.
overlaps.crossLink: directiveWrapped / semanticFunction on the question row

overlaps.why: Entities asks who is referenced; Codes asks how Q marked the reference. "HRC" and "[HRC]" are different analytical objects.
A repeated question is a stylistic fact in Emphasis and a unit in Questions. Repetition being USED rhetorically is a different observation from the question existing.
overlaps.crossLink: emphasis type repeated_question, matched on post + text

overlaps.why: Same reasoning as repeated questions: the instruction is the unit, the repetition is the device.
overlaps.crossLink: emphasis type repeated_directive, matched on post + text

overlaps.why: isConclusion is an ATTRIBUTE of a claim or a prediction, not a separate population. It must never be added to the claims total.
Both are assertions and share storage; displayClass decides which section shows a unit. The combined figure appears only where labelled combined.
